description: Fraction addition and multiplication use the usual cross-sum and numerator-product formulas, negation negates the numerator, nonzero inversion swaps coordinates, and a fraction is zero exactly when its numerator is zero.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rational_representative_formulas
  (p q : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.FractionRep) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalAdd (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalClass p)
        (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalClass q) =
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalClass (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.fractionAdd p q) ∧
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalMul (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalClass p)
          (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalClass q) =
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalClass (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.fractionMul p q) ∧
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalNeg (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalClass p) =
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalClass (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.fractionNeg p) ∧
        (∀ (hp : p.1 ≠ 0),
            Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalInv (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalClass p) =
              Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalClass (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.fractionInv p hp)) ∧
          (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalValue (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NumberSystems.rationalClass p) = 0 ↔
            p.1 = 0)
